clean.root_cause: The agent stopped searching after opening only a subset of drawers and never located the dishsponge, leaving the task incomplete.
clean.evidence: Final action 'go to countertop 1' after opening drawers 1-6 (all empty), with no further attempt to find the dishsponge.
clean.corrective_rule: Systematically search all receptacles (all drawers, cabinets, countertops, and other furniture) before concluding the object is absent.
clean.skill_tree_gap: Lacks a thorough search strategy for objects not immediately visible, leading to premature termination.

pick_two_obj_and_place.root_cause: The agent picked up only one keychain and then stopped, failing to collect the required second keychain.
pick_two_obj_and_place.evidence: Action 'take keychain 2 from sidetable 2' succeeded, then no further actions; the second keychain was never sought.
pick_two_obj_and_place.corrective_rule: After picking up one target object, continue searching for the second target object before proceeding to the destination.
pick_two_obj_and_place.skill_tree_gap: The agent lacks an understanding of multi-object collection requirements; it treats the task as single-object once one is found.
